decision.rationale: The dispute is within the time limit. TXN-008036 posted on 2026-08-26 and the dispute was opened on 2026-10-28, which is 63 days later, inside the 120-day limit. The ledger shows two purchases at LUMEN BRASSERIE (MER-000002) on this card, each for 10076 EUR minor units and both posted on 2026-08-26. TXN-008035 was made at 12:13 on 2026-08-25 under AUTH-008231, which was contactless, approved and not flagged for fraud. TXN-008036 was made at 15:13 the same day under AUTH-008232, which used the chip with the PIN verified, was approved and was not flagged for fraud. The two postings do not share an authorisation. Each was authorised on its own, three hours apart, using different entry methods. That makes them two separate purchases, not one authorisation posted twice. No refund appears on the card. Under the separate-authorisations rule for duplicate charges, the dispute is declined.
